Post Mount
Vinylast started making post mounts in the mid 90's and has elevated the program to offer the safest, strongest,
most secure and tested post mount on the market today. Designed to replace a wood guard post it can be attached
to wood decks, porches and concrete patios easlil and with the adjustable top block allows both 36" and 42"
railing heights to be easlily installed
1.) CCRR certified and tested to both IRC and IBC building codes.
2.) For use with 36" and 42" railing heights.
3.) "Shore Coated" and salt spray tested to 1000 hours for coastal applications
4.) Wood deck,  concreat mounting and leveling kits available
5.) Adaptor blocks and clip on spacers for 5" and 6" vinyl sleeves.
6.) 2pcs leveling shims included.
7.) Precision robotic welds ensure a strong, secure  base attachment.
